answer: Zenith-pass proof: each identity runs a $240 sky camera on a surveyed karst outcrop and must photograph the Raven-1 satellite flashing as it crosses the zenith, timestamped to the second. A grader matches the photo star field against the predicted sky for those exact coordinates; a copied or stock image fails the match. A farm of 100 fakes needs 100 cameras at 100 distinct sites, $24,000, while one honest agent runs a single camera.
